charter.claim: R-034 native new-process save/load and resumed durable behavior
charter.material_proof: A current-source run must produce meaningful package state through native play, record actor identity/rules/assignment and any durable camp state before save, save through native input, exit the original process, reload the exact world in a new source-bound process without fixture reinstall, reject stale prior-process grants, compare durable identities and values, and observe later ordinary behavior rebuilding derived services without duplicate effects.
charter.current_uncertainty: Fresh package changes have not yet been independently shown to preserve their changed durable state through native process replacement and continued behavior.
material_contradiction: Native save or process exit is not confirmed.
Reload does not reach the same saved world in a new process/generation.
A stale prior-process frame or UID can act on the new owner.
A durable identity, rule, assignment, mission, item, zone, policy, or relevant ecology value differs after reload without an explained native transition.
Later ordinary behavior fails to rebuild a derived service or double-applies a report, payment, or terminal effect.
already_accepted_evidence: The fixture and startup are setup and source-binding evidence only.
Historical camp, NPC, zone, item, and save observations remain at their original narrow scope and are not persistence proof for this fresh run.
The unpromoted Patrol priority-zero contradiction is preserved and must not be replayed or repaired here.
forbidden_shortcuts: Direct save mutation, fixture restage, or debug state injection.
Physical-key, guessed-key, OCR, terminal-text, or rendered-text control/proof.
Treating a stale frame, process exit, saved file, or cleanup result as restored gameplay.
honest_stop_conditions: A named native save or lifecycle failure is observed and preserved.
A required current native owner or source-bound process replacement remains unavailable.
The restored durable state or continued behavior contradicts the requested outcome.
